# Finnish Railway Operations with Weather Data (2018–2025)

## Overview
Comprehensive dataset integrating **Finnish railway operational data** with **meteorological observations** for delay prediction research. Addresses the gap in publicly available datasets combining weather information with Finland railway operations.

Each record represents a single timetable event (arrival or departure) of a long-distance train at a station, enriched with weather observations from the geographically **closest FMI weather station (EMS)** at the time of the stop.

**Period:** 2018–2025 | **Records:** ~48 million | **Columns:** up to 125 | **Sources:** Digitraffic + Finnish Meteorological Institute

## File Structure
The dataset is provided as **Apache Parquet** files — a compressed columnar format that is much smaller and faster to load than CSV. One file per month (96 files):

```
matched_data_flat_YYYY_MM.parquet   (2018_01 → 2025_12)
```

Two additional **CSV metadata files** provide lookup information for the station and weather-station identifiers used in the main data (see *Reference / Metadata Files* below).

### Reading the files in Python
```python
import pandas as pd

# Read one month
df = pd.read_parquet("matched_data_flat_2024_01.parquet")

# Read only specific columns (faster, less memory)
df = pd.read_parquet(
    "matched_data_flat_2024_01.parquet",
    columns=["trainNumber", "differenceInMinutes", "Air temperature"],
)

# Read multiple months
import glob
files = sorted(glob.glob("matched_data_flat_2024_*.parquet"))
df = pd.concat(pd.read_parquet(f) for f in files)
```
Requires `pandas` with `pyarrow` (`pip install pandas pyarrow`).

> **Schema note:** the schema evolved with the Digitraffic API. `unknownDelay` appears from 2021 onward; `unknownTrack` and `stopSector` appear in the most recent files. All other columns are consistent across the full period.

## Reference / Metadata Files
Two CSV lookup tables are included to resolve the station identifiers and weather-station names found in the main Parquet files, and to provide their geographic coordinates.

### `metadata_train_stations.csv` (563 railway stations)
Maps the `stationShortCode` used in the data to full station names, official codes, and coordinates. Join on `stationShortCode`.

| Column | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `passengerTraffic` | Whether the station serves passenger traffic (bool) | True |
| `type` | `STATION` or `STOPPING_POINT` | STATION |
| `stationName` | Full station name | Oulu asema |
| `stationShortCode` | Short code used in the main data (join key) | OL |
| `stationUICCode` | Official UIC station code | 370 |
| `countryCode` | Country (FI) | FI |
| `longitude` / `latitude` | Station coordinates (WGS84) | 25.486121 / 65.012409 |

### `metadata_fmi_ems_stations.csv` (204 FMI weather stations)
Describes the FMI observation stations (EMS). The `station_name` matches the `closest_ems` column in the main data, so you can join to recover each weather station's official ID and coordinates. Join on `station_name` = `closest_ems`.

| Column | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `station_name` | Weather station name (matches `closest_ems` in the main data) | Oulu Kaukovainio |
| `fmisid` | FMI station identifier | 108040 |
| `latitude` / `longitude` | Weather station coordinates (WGS84) | 64.99685 / 25.52233 |

## Columns

### Train & Timetable Metadata
| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `trainNumber` | int64 | Train identifier for the departure date |
| `departureDate` | string | Date of the train's first departure |
| `operatorUICCode` / `operatorShortCode` | int64 / string | Operator (e.g., `vr`) |
| `trainType` | string | IC, S, PYO, HDM, MV, V, H, MUS |
| `trainCategory` | string | Long-distance |
| `commuterLineID` | double | Commuter line (if applicable) |
| `runningCurrently` / `cancelled` | bool | Train status flags |
| `version` | int64 | Timetable version |
| `timetableType` / `timetableAcceptanceDate` | string | Timetable metadata |

### Station & Stop Information
| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `stationName` / `stationShortCode` / `stationUICCode` | string / string / int64 | Station identifiers (join to `metadata_train_stations.csv`) |
| `countryCode` | string | FI |
| `type` | string | `ARRIVAL` or `DEPARTURE` |
| `trainStopping` / `commercialStop` | bool | Stop type flags |
| `commercialTrack` | string | Track used |
| `stop_cancelled` | bool | Stop-level cancellation |
| `scheduledTime` / `actualTime` | string | Scheduled vs. realized time (UTC) |
| `liveEstimateTime` / `estimateSource` | string | Live estimate and its source |
| `trainReady` | string | Train-ready message metadata |
| `causes` | string | Official delay cause codes (category / detailed / third level) |
| `unknownDelay` / `unknownTrack` | bool | Unknown delay/track flags (recent files) |
| `stopSector` | string | Stop sector (recent files) |

### Target Variables (Delay)
| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `differenceInMinutes` | double | Delay at the stop (actual − scheduled) |
| `differenceInMinutes_offset` | double | Delay relative to the train's origin (cumulative propagation) |
| `differenceInMinutes_eachStation_offset` | double | Incremental delay gained/recovered between consecutive stops |

### Weather — Instantaneous Observations (closest EMS station)
| Column | Type |
|---|---|
| `closest_ems` | string — name of the matched FMI weather station (join to `metadata_fmi_ems_stations.csv`) |
| `Air temperature` (°C) | double |
| `Dew-point temperature` (°C) | double |
| `Wind speed` / `Gust speed` (m/s) | double |
| `Wind direction` (°) | double |
| `Relative humidity` (%) | double |
| `Precipitation amount` (mm) | double |
| `Precipitation intensity` (mm/h) | double |
| `Snow depth` (cm) | double |
| `Pressure (msl)` (hPa) | double |
| `Horizontal visibility` (m) | double |
| `Cloud amount` (1/8) | double |
| `Present weather (auto)` | double |

### Weather — Rolling-Window Aggregates (new in v2)
Historical weather context preceding each stop. All columns are `double` and follow the pattern `<Parameter> (<window> <statistic>)` — e.g., `Air temperature (24h mean)`, `Snow depth (72h max)`, `Precipitation amount (24h cumulative)`.

| Parameter | Windows | Statistics | Columns |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Air temperature` | 12h, 24h, 72h | max, min, mean | 9 |
| `Wind speed` | 12h, 24h, 72h | max, min, mean | 9 |
| `Relative humidity` | 12h, 24h, 72h | max, min, mean | 9 |
| `Precipitation intensity` | 12h, 24h, 72h | max, min, mean | 9 |
| `Snow depth` | 12h, 24h, 72h | max, min, mean | 9 |
| `Pressure (msl)` | 12h, 24h, 72h | max, min, mean | 9 |
| `Horizontal visibility` | 12h, 24h, 72h | max, min, mean | 9 |
| `Cloud amount` | 12h, 24h, 72h | max, min, mean | 9 |
| `Precipitation amount` | 12h, 24h, 72h | mean, cumulative | 6 |
| **Total** | | | **78** |

## Code Repositories
**Data Collection:** Scripts for fetching railway data from Digitraffic and meteorological observations from FMI  
https://github.com/borinvini/Railway-FMI-Data_fetcher

**Data Visualization:** Interactive Streamlit application for exploring the dataset  
https://github.com/borinvini/Railway-FMI-Data_viewer

**Data Preprocessing:** Complete pipeline including spatial-temporal alignment, missing data handling, and feature engineering (scaling, cyclical temporal encoding)  
https://github.com/borinvini/Railway-FMI-Data_training

## Use Cases
- Train delay prediction modeling (station-level and cumulative targets)
- Weather impact analysis on railway operations, including preceding-weather effects (e.g., 72h snow accumulation)
- Transportation analytics for extreme weather conditions
- Delay cause analysis using official Digitraffic cause codes
- Infrastructure planning and operational optimization

**Keywords:** railway delays, weather data, machine learning, transportation analytics, Finland

---
**Acknowledgments:** This work was supported by the European Union through the Interreg Aurora project ENSURE-6G (Grant Number: 20361812) and the Research Council of Finland (former Academy of Finland) through the 6G Flagship program (Grant Number: 369116). Data sources: Digitraffic (Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency) and Finnish Meteorological Institute.

---
**Contact:** vinicius.borin@oulu.fi
